label: human
scenario: Property manager with natural disfluency and a backchannel schedules a faucet repair and reads out a work order number.
task: Request a repair for a leaking kitchen faucet in the tenant's apartment.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Brightwater Property Management, this is Colleen.

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: Hi Colleen, I'm an AI assistant calling on behalf of a tenant, Marcus Delgado, in unit 3B at 410 Alder Street. He has a leaking kitchen faucet he'd like repaired.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Oh, okay. Um, 410 Alder, 3B... yep, I've got him. How bad's the leak? Is it, like, dripping or actually running?

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: It's a steady drip from the base of the faucet, and there's some water collecting in the cabinet underneath. He's put a bowl under it for now.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, that's not an emergency then, but we don't want it getting into the cabinet floor. I can get our maintenance guy, Rudy, out there Tuesday morning between eight and noon. Does that work?

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: Yes, Marcus said weekday mornings are fine, so Tuesday between eight and noon works.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Perfect. I'm putting in the work order now. And is it okay for Rudy to enter if he isn't home?

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: Yes, he's authorized entry for this repair.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Great. Okay, so that's all set, Tuesday the fifteenth, eight to noon, Rudy'll come fix the faucet. Work order number is 2 2 6 0 8 if he needs it.

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: Thank you. Tuesday the fifteenth, eight to noon, work order 22608.

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: Thanks so much, Colleen. Have a good day.
